newsitem.title: CANADA: Laidlaw, Rollins sign definitive deal.
newsitem.headline: Laidlaw, Rollins sign definitive deal.

text.p: Laidlaw Inc and Rollins Environmental Services Inc said on Thursday that they have signed a definitive agreement to sell Laidlaw's hazardous waste management unit, Laidlaw Environmental Services, to Rollins.
The definitive agreement follows a letter of intent which announced the proposed deal on January 6, the companies said in a joint statement.
Under the agreement, Laidlaw will receive US$400 million in cash, 120 million common shares of Rollins, and a US$350 million, 12-year, 5 percent convertible debenture.
The company will be renamed Laidlaw Environmental Services Inc and continue to trade on The New York Stock Exchange.
Laidlaw will own 66 percent of the equity in the combined operation, expected to generate in excess of US$900 million in annual revenue.
The transaction, which is subject to regulatory considerations and a vote of Rollins' shareholders at a special meeting in March, is expected to close in April.
